We first load the required packages
```{r}
library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidytree)
library(ape)
library(geiger)
library(phytools)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
library(cowplot)
library(tidyr)
```

Load the data
```{r}
setwd(dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path))
data <- read.csv("Comparative_primate_steepness_values_clean.csv")

#and prepare it
data_alt <- data %>%
  group_by(species, sex) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_steepness = mean(steepness, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_studies = n())
```





```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare data and phylogeny for Figure 1
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Create a copy of the dataset for the figure.
# The original dataset (data) is kept unchanged for traceability.
data_fig1 <- data %>%
  mutate(
    species = recode(
      species,
      "Cebus_apella" = "Sapajus_apella"
    )
  )

# Load the phylogeny
phylogeny <- read.nexus("Upham2019MammalPhylogeny.nex")

# Update the taxonomic name in the phylogeny
# Cebus apella -> Sapajus apella
phylogeny$tip.label[
  phylogeny$tip.label == "Cebus_apella"
] <- "Sapajus_apella"

# Species list corresponding to the harmonised names used in Figure 1
specieslist <- data.frame(
  species = unique(data_fig1$species),
  row.names = unique(data_fig1$species)
)

# Check whether the species in our data are present in the phylogeny
speciesmatching <- name.check(phylogeny, specieslist)

# Species present in the data but absent from the phylogeny
speciesmatching$data_not_tree

# Reduce the phylogeny to the species included in our dataset
mtree <- drop.tip(
  phylogeny,
  speciesmatching$tree_not_data
)
```


---------------------------
TREE - FIGURE 1
---------------------------

```{r}
# Number of matrices per species (for tip point size)
data_N <- data_fig1 %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(Nmatrices = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    species_label = str_replace_all(species, "_", " "),
    species_label = str_to_sentence(species_label)
  )

# Average steepness per species and sex (wide format)
data_steep_wide <- data_fig1 %>%
  group_by(species, sex) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_steepness = mean(steepness, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sex = recode(
      sex,
      "M" = "males",
      "F" = "females",
      "male" = "males",
      "female" = "females"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sex,
    values_from = mean_steepness
  )
```


```{r}
# --- Base tree ----------------------------------------------------------------
p <- ggtree(mtree) + theme_tree()
p2 <- p %<+% data_N

# Vertical stretching for readability
p2$data$y <- p2$data$y * 2

# --- Tip positions ------------------------------------------------------------
tip_positions <- p2$data %>%
  filter(isTip) %>%
  select(label, x, y) %>%
  rename(species = label)

tree_max_x <- max(tip_positions$x)

# --- Steepness gauge positioning ----------------------------------------------
x_axis_start_F <- tree_max_x + 28   # females axis (left)
x_axis_start_M <- tree_max_x + 42   # males axis (right)
axis_length     <- 8                 # visual length representing 0 to 1

axis_data <- data_steep_wide %>%
  left_join(tip_positions, by = "species") %>%
  mutate(
    # Female axis
    seg_F_x    = x_axis_start_F,
    seg_F_xend = x_axis_start_F + axis_length,
    pt_F_x     = x_axis_start_F + females * axis_length,
    label_F_x  = x_axis_start_F + axis_length + 0.8,
    # Male axis
    seg_M_x    = x_axis_start_M,
    seg_M_xend = x_axis_start_M + axis_length,
    pt_M_x     = x_axis_start_M + males * axis_length,
    label_M_x  = x_axis_start_M + axis_length + 0.8
  )

# Y positions for tick labels (top of each axis = species with highest y)
y_tick_F <- axis_data %>% filter(!is.na(females)) %>% slice_max(y, n = 1) %>% pull(y)
y_tick_M <- axis_data %>% filter(!is.na(males))   %>% slice_max(y, n = 1) %>% pull(y)

# Dummy data for clade legend
clade_legend <- data.frame(
  clade = factor(c("Platyrrhini", "Cercopithecoidea", "Hominoidea"),
                 levels = c("Platyrrhini", "Cercopithecoidea", "Hominoidea")),
  x = NA, y = NA
)
```


```{r}
p_final <- p2 +
  geom_hilight(node = 70, fill = "#8da0cb", alpha = 0.18) +
  geom_hilight(node = 41, fill = "#66c2a5", alpha = 0.18) +
  geom_hilight(node = 67, fill = "#fc8d62", alpha = 0.18) +

  geom_tippoint(aes(size = Nmatrices),
                shape = 21, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +

  geom_tiplab(aes(label = species_label),
              size = 3.8, offset = 4, align = TRUE,
              linetype = "dotted", fontface = "italic") +

  # Male axis segments
  geom_segment(data = axis_data %>% filter(!is.na(males)),
               aes(x = seg_M_x, xend = seg_M_xend, y = y, yend = y),
               color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  # Female axis segments
  geom_segment(data = axis_data %>% filter(!is.na(females)),
               aes(x = seg_F_x, xend = seg_F_xend, y = y, yend = y),
               color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  # Male point
  geom_point(data = axis_data %>% filter(!is.na(males)),
             aes(x = pt_M_x, y = y),
             color = "gold3", size = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  # Female point
  geom_point(data = axis_data %>% filter(!is.na(females)),
             aes(x = pt_F_x, y = y),
             color = "#443A83FF", size = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # Male labels
geom_text(
  data = axis_data %>% filter(!is.na(males)),
  aes(x = label_M_x, y = y, label = sprintf("%.2f", males)),
  color = "gold3",
  hjust = 0,
  size = 2.8,
  fontface = "bold",
  inherit.aes = FALSE
) +

# Female labels
geom_text(
  data = axis_data %>% filter(!is.na(females)),
  aes(x = label_F_x, y = y, label = sprintf("%.2f", females)),
  color = "#443A83FF",
  hjust = 0,
  size = 2.8,
  fontface = "bold",
  inherit.aes = FALSE
) +


  # Titles
  annotate("text", x = x_axis_start_F + axis_length/2,
         y = max(axis_data$y) + 2, label = "Females",
         color = "#443A83FF", fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
  annotate("text", x = x_axis_start_M + axis_length/2,
         y = max(axis_data$y) + 2, label = "Males",
         color = "gold3", fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +

  # Tick labels 0 and 1
 annotate("text", x = x_axis_start_F,
         y = y_tick_F + 1.2, label = "0", size = 3.2, color = "grey40") +
annotate("text", x = x_axis_start_F + axis_length,
         y = y_tick_F + 1.2, label = "1", size = 3.2, color = "grey40") +
annotate("text", x = x_axis_start_M,
         y = y_tick_M + 1.2, label = "0", size = 3.2, color = "grey40") +
annotate("text", x = x_axis_start_M + axis_length,
         y = y_tick_M + 1.2, label = "1", size = 3.2, color = "grey40") +

  # Legend
  geom_point(data = clade_legend,
             aes(x = x, y = y, fill = clade),
             shape = 22, size = 4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Platyrrhini" = "#8da0cb",
               "Cercopithecoidea" = "#66c2a5",
               "Hominoidea" = "#fc8d62"),
    name = "Clade") +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("males" = "gold3", "females" = "#443A83FF"),
    name = NULL) +

  scale_size_area(
    max_size = 6, name = "N matrices",
    breaks = round(seq(min(data_N$Nmatrices),
                       max(data_N$Nmatrices), length.out = 4))) +

  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(shape = 22, size = 5)),
    size = guide_legend(order = 3)) +

  ggtitle("Average steepness") +
  
  # A = arbre
annotate(
  "text",
  x = tree_max_x / 2,
  y = max(axis_data$y) + 4,
  label = "A",
  fontface = "bold",
  size = 5.5
) +

# B = noms des espèces
annotate(
  "text",
  x = tree_max_x + 7,
  y = max(axis_data$y) + 4,
  label = "B",
  fontface = "bold",
  size = 5.5
) +

# C = valeurs de steepness
annotate(
  "text",
  x = x_axis_start_F - 2,
  y = max(axis_data$y) + 4,
  label = "C",
  fontface = "bold",
  size = 5.5
) +


  coord_cartesian(
  xlim = c(0, x_axis_start_M + axis_length + 12),
  clip = "off"
) +

  theme_tree() +
scale_x_continuous(
  breaks = c(0, 25, 50),          
  limits = c(0, NA),
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
) +
theme(
  axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
  axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
  legend.position = c(0.08, 0.55),
  legend.justification = c(0, 0.5),
  legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
  plot.margin = margin(20, 40, 20, 10),
  plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.85, fontface = "bold", size = 15)
)

p_final
```
